title: Handling Impressions and Door Handles
summary: This topic mainly covers praise for how the G60 drives and handles, alongside one complaint about the underhand door-handle design, but many fragments are too brief to classify confidently.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car's handling and driving feel, describing it as confident, enjoyable, and well-executed.

negative.summary: Negative feedback is limited to a complaint that the underhand door-handle design feels awkward to use.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mostly mention handling or door handles in short or incomplete phrases, so the exact sentiment often cannot be confirmed.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are very short phrases such as 'handles well' or 'the way it handles,' which limits precise sentiment interpretation.
